mods.description: Steam-powered proximity voice chat for Better than Adventure!

releases.notes:
This alpha adds microphone muting and completes the shared e4BTA settings integration.

- Press M to mute or unmute your microphone by default.
- See and change your mute state directly in the V voice overlay.
- Rebind the mute key from the e4BTA options page.
- Test your microphone while muted without transmitting the test to other players.

Requires at least e4BTA 0.6.0. This is still a pre-release and may contain issues.

releases.notes:
## e4BTA Voice 0.1.0 Alpha 1

The first public alpha of e4BTA Voice, a Steam powered proximity voice chat mod for Better than Adventure! 8.0.1.

### Features

- Positional proximity voice chat
- Push to talk and open microphone modes
- In game voice settings opened with V
- Microphone loopback testing
- Per player volume controls from 0% to 600%
- Password protected voice groups without distance limits
- Optional communication with players outside your group

### Requirements

- Better than Adventure! 8.0.1
- e4BTA 0.5.1 or newer
- HalpLibe 6.1.4 or newer
- Steam running and signed in

Install the jar on the server and every client using voice chat.

> This is an alpha release. Bugs and voice connection issues may (and probably will) still occur.
